description: This is a Flutter Dart source file defining a StatefulWidget called DashboardScreen that composes a dashboard UI with multiple sub-widgets, including header, hero promo card, featured tiles, curated carousel, and bottom navigation. It constructs a responsive, scrollable layout with custom theming and layout adjustments based on device info.
